about.text: We craft digital artifacts for those who live between worlds. Our space is bulit for creators, collectors, and the quietly obsessed.

list.title: What are the NFTs?
list.text: NFTs (non-fungible tokens) are unique digital objects stored on the blockchain. They can be art,music, code, memes, memories - anything that can be owned and vertfied.No coples. No takes, Just you and the chain.
